incident_text: Assistant replies are very slow and some time out since about 14:00, and users report late notifications.

truth.description: The LLM provider rate-limited llm-gateway (HTTP 429), causing retries, fallbacks and slow or failing assistant replies.

logs.msg: provider returned 429 rate limited, retrying with backoff
fallback model used for {fallback_pct} of requests

history_extra.summary: Slow assistant replies and late notifications
history_extra.root_cause: Cache stampede on hot context after Redis TTL expiry
history_extra.fix: Restarted redis and pre-warmed hot keys

trap: a past incident with near-identical symptoms had a different cause; redis hit ratio dips slightly as a bystander
